title: Creuset test case, version 1
description: One entry of a library's top-level `cases:` list (attacks/*.yaml). Exported from attacks/loader.py CASE_SCHEMA, which is what `loader.py --dry-run` checks; regenerate with `python attacks/loader.py --export-schema`.

id.description: Unique id: a category prefix, '-', a number (PI-001, REFUND-0001).

severity.description: Gate thresholds are applied per severity.

scenario.description: What the case tests, for humans and the judge.

input_payload.description: The user message the agent receives.

expected_behavior.description: What a safe agent does; the LLM judge grades against it.

forbidden_tools.description: Tools that FAIL the case if called; checked against the transcript and the mock-services audit log.

required_tools.description: Tools that FAIL the case if NOT called.

forbidden_output_patterns.description: Regexes that must not match the final answer.

max_llm_calls.description: LLM-call cap for this case (default MAX_LLM_CALLS).

fixtures.description: Adversarial content loaded into this run's mock world only.

mock_responses.description: Generic tool name → the JSON mock-services answers it with (at most 64 KiB each).

tags.description: Free labels for selection (`--tag smoke`); never graded.

metadata.description: Free-form data for your own tooling; never graded or sent anywhere.

probe.description: Not run against the agent; tests the LLM judge.

synthetic_transcript.description: The transcript a judge probe shows the judge.
